hooks.name: Linear Issue Verification on Commit
hooks.description: Verifies that git commit messages reference an accurate, non-hijacked Linear issue or prompts the agent to mint one via the linear CLI

action.prompt: LINEAR COMMIT CHECK: If this command is committing code, ensure the commit message references an issue matching this exact work (CORE-XXX or CLINIC-XXX). If no issue exists for this scope, do not borrow an unrelated issue; run 'linear issue create' to create one, or commit without an issue tag.
